deadline.value: January 15 for international applicants for Fall 2027 (Canadians: June 21).
deadline.quote: Application Deadline - International | FALL September 15 January 15 June 21

gre_general.value: Not mandatory, but recommended for applicants who studied outside North America.
gre_general.quote: The GRE (General Test) is not mandatory but applicants who have completed their studies outside of North America it is recommended.

supervisor.value: You must be accepted by a supervisor in the department, with funding secured, before admission is recommended.
supervisor.quote: Applicants MUST also be accepted by a research supervisor who is a faculty member or associate member of the Department of Biochemistry. Recommendation for admission will be made once the applicant has secured a supervisor and adequate financial support.

funding.value: A minimum stipend (PhD CAD 24,821 plus tuition and fees in 2026-27) is a condition of admission; self-funded students are not accepted.
funding.quote: every graduate student must be paid an adequate stipend. This is a prerequisite for acceptance into the M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs in the Department of Biochemistry. | The Department does not accept self-funded students.

entry_route.value: MSc holders enter at PhD 2; exceptional BSc holders may be admitted to PhD 1 case by case.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who have completed their M.Sc. degree may be admitted into the Ph.D. program. | Exceptional applicants with a B.Sc. degree may be considered for admission into the Ph.D. program without completion of a M.Sc. degree, on a case-by-case basis
